cards.front: How do you multiply two binomials using the [[kw:Distributive Property]]?
cards.back: Distribute each term of the first binomial to every term of the second: $$ (a+b)(c+d) = a(c+d) + b(c+d) $$ Then distribute again and combine like terms.
$$ x^{2} + 7x + 10 $$ Distribute: $ x(x+5) + 2(x+5) = x^{2}+5x+2x+10 $, then combine $ 5x+2x $.
